notes: One file drives Newest, Pending, and Recently Sold. Status Active, Coming Soon, or New Listing appears under Newest. Status Pending or Under Contract appears under Pending. Status Sold appears under Recently Sold. Sold rows are the whole Adam Druck Group, refreshed by scripts/import_closed_sales.py. Each sold row's agents list is the public credit, shown as Sold by. Buyer-side sold rows must keep side buyer, photoAllowed false, and image null. Listing-side sold rows may set image later to a verified photo of that property. Do not invent prices, dates, or photos.
